steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Surely you realize how vital an "anomalous power expert" is to the city-state right now. And you'd risk turning me into a vegetable for a hunch?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Think carefully. Can you afford to take that risk?
Hilda freezes mid-motion, her gaze turning inward in brief contemplation.
In the end, she puts the syringe down.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Then prove it to me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Since you insist you're an anomalous power expert, demonstrate this so-called "expertise" of yours.
You want to present your evidence, to reason with her, but you already attempted that the moment you entered the LINK system... Here, your shackles hold no power.
You can only watch as she slowly removes her gloves. Each step she takes toward you is measured, deliberate, and final.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: What's wrong? Afraid? Shouldn't an "expert" have methods to regulate this anomalous power?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You've been speaking with me all this time, yet you failed to detect the power I possess. That alone is suspicious. So if you have any way to prove yourself, use it on me. Now.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Otherwise, you will die.
The red gloves come off, revealing her bone-white fingers. Delicate, gilt patterns trace their way across her skin as Mania—a flowing, liquid light—gathers in her palms.
The patterns resemble Aurum Secretum, yet they are alien, ones you've never seen.
Hilda doesn't care for your hesitation. She grabs your wrist and locks her fingers with yours, hard.
In an instant, black spikes erupt through both your palms. You feel the cool, rigid texture of her fingers a moment before the true agony hits: the violent invasion of her Mania into your veins.
You grit your teeth and endure.
A soft sigh escapes her. Her face is a mask, but her grip tightens.
A second, more brutal wave of Mania shatters through your hands. This time, it brings not just pain, but a cacophony of shrieking echoes that floods your mind, wracking your body with tremors.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Mmph...!
As your legs buckle, she catches you. Through the blinding pain, you see her gaze soften, then harden into unmistakable disappointment.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: See? You're still lying.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You have no ability to control the anomalous power... When confronted with it, all you can do is endure the pain.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Now then, I want you to tell me very carefully... who are you, really?
Clank.
The world swims. You collapse, overturning the basin of soaking documents. As crimson-stained papers drift down around you, your fading vision catches the writing Edward left behind—
(Flashback filter)
[In the car]

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: A spy's identity is usually a fabrication, of course. But to make a falsehood convincing... that requires a certain "technique."

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: My preferred method is what I call "double-layering." I present the target with an initial identity. Something simple, a little too clean, almost easy to see through. Then, I subtly guide them to become suspicious, to investigate on their own.

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: The more little discrepancies they dig up, the more they trust the "truth" they've uncovered for themselves. Set up the pieces just right, then... you're all set.
(Filter ends) [Black Screen]
So, Edward never intended the "anomalous power expert" to be your "true" identity. It was merely the first layer of a deception.
He must have known you were a fraud and that Hilda would see through it. His solution was to embed a second, backup identity directly into the files.
You can't tell if the bastard meant to set you up or save you. The only thing that matters now is the document before your eyes. You burn every word, every detail, into your mind.
Next time... you will absolutely...
